passages.field: A cylindrical vessel mentioning Ix Yax We’n Chaak; dedicatory text
passages.text: It got sanctified? (it got raised?) the painted drinking cup for fruity cocoa (of) yo?[…] […] Ix Yax We’n Chaak, sovereign of Baax Witz, chief of the land
passages.remark: Damaged dedicatory passage with proposed reconstructions. Attribution: Guido Krempel, Sebastián Matteo and Dmitri Beliaev, Research Note 23.
